params.name: country
params.description: Specify the country code of the alerts request. This is a required parameter. The reference for acceptable values is ISO 3166 two-letter codes (alpha-2). example: US

params.name: language
params.description: Specify the language the language to use in the text values of the alert. Values should follow RFC 3066. example: en-US

params.name: sender
params.description: Specify the source of the alerts request. example: NWS

params.name: event
params.description: When specified, the API will return only alerts that match the specified event types. example: Flood Warning

params.name: startTime
params.description: Specify the date and time alerts are sent. When set, all alerts sent from this timestamp are returned. ISO8601 date-time format specified int RFC 3339. example: 2022-11-25T00:00:00

params.name: endTime
params.description: Specify the date and time alerts are sent. When set, all alerts sent until this timestamp are returned. ISO8601 date-time format specified int RFC 3339. example: 2022-11-26T00:00:00

params.name: excludeGeometry
params.description: Specify whether or not to include the geojson geometry for each alert.

params.name: showTotal
params.description: Specify whether or not to include total number of alerts.
